name: Code Slayer
description: A comprehensive full-stack online judge system that enables users to solve coding problems with secure multi-language code execution. Features a real-time code editor with Monaco Editor, automated judge system, and AI-assisted code review.
bullets: Built full-stack Online Judge System serving 50+ students daily with secure code execution under strict time & memory limits
Developed real-time code editor (Monaco Editor) with scalable REST APIs supporting problem management, authentication, and submission history
Optimized MongoDB schemas to handle 10,000+ records efficiently with JWT authentication and bcrypt hashing, reducing login errors by 25%
Containerized code execution engine with Docker, improving evaluation speed by 40% with average execution time under 2 seconds
Deployed services on AWS EC2, Render, and Vercel ensuring high availability and scalability
Integrated AI-assisted code review system using Gemini API to provide intelligent feedback and enhance learning experience
Validated system performance with 500+ test submissions achieving consistent reliability and user satisfaction

name: MarketPulse-X
description: Real-time portfolio intelligence system that detects supply chain disruptions from live news and analyzes cascading impacts on tracked investments using AI. Implements sophisticated backend processing pipeline with WebSocket real-time alerts.
bullets: Built real-time portfolio intelligence system detecting supply chain disruptions from live news feeds with multi-source integration (Finnhub, NewsAPI, RSS)
Designed 7-stage backend processing pipeline for event validation, relationship extraction, impact inference, scoring, and AI-powered explanation generation using FastAPI
Integrated Google Gemini AI to extract supply chain relationships (e.g., TSMC → Apple) and infer downstream portfolio impacts with high accuracy
Implemented WebSocket-based real-time alerts broadcasting critical market events instantly to connected clients with <1 second latency
Containerized all services using Docker and deployed on Kubernetes cluster, gaining hands-on experience with orchestration, auto-scaling, and service reliability
Integrated live market data using Yahoo Finance APIs for continuous portfolio monitoring and impact analysis
System handles 1000+ concurrent connections with 99.9% uptime during market volatility

name: Expense Tracker
description: A lightweight Python desktop application for personal financial management. Enables transaction categorization, budget tracking, and comprehensive financial analytics with interactive visualizations.
bullets: Designed and implemented full-featured Personal Expense Tracker with intuitive Tkinter GUI for seamless user experience
Enabled users to add, edit, and categorize transactions (income & expenses) with flexible monthly budget setting and tracking
Developed persistent SQLite database with optimized queries for fast retrieval of financial records and analytics
Integrated advanced analytics engine with Matplotlib for interactive visualization of budget usage and spending breakdowns
Provides comprehensive financial reports and insights helping users understand spending patterns and manage budgets effectively
